reviews.review: Game is lit a copy of MUCK, barely any content for the price, BORING ending. Overall slightly better version of MUCK BUT it costs alot.
Needs more updates or a fleshed out roadmap, otherwise its a great game!

These are my upgrades in my lobby as master and its increasing...
- Healing flask 2
- Healing shrines 2
- Big money 3
- physically fit 2
- Spell dabbler 7
- Giga glug-glugger 2
- Big stepper 1
- armored 1
my friends have other things upgraded but...

The healing shrines and sword in the bone including amp up chest, all of my friends have and ofc upgraded more. I'm not sure if it stacks but it feels like it does not. We barely find sword in the bone on duos and healing shrines are less common the more we get into the story. we have yet to get past trip 4. even the camps are less vs easy mode there's more.
trip 4 wants you to have legendary weapon already and everything is so expensive. so with the difficulty of the monster, making money is so hard. trip 3, everything is 600-1k and a few 2k. trip 4 for us is 3.5k+ but mostly 4k or 6k.
--trip 3, we didn't find keys since trip 2 and the items we were getting was duplicates or...just a bunch of bows on trip 2. when we didn't even use that character.

We've played in a 4 squad and the first 2 trips were okay. my issue with trip 2, why is the dagger elf WAY stronger than anything on the map including the dagger character himself and they're faster than anyone?(I always have speed boots)
why is everything so hard to see and spread out? why is the main ones i see is red? I had 10 blue and by the end of the trip, 13. trip 3, its mainly a mix of everything but this time barely green. left that trip with 17 vs the first trip i had 10. 4th trip, its mainly red and all the others are spread out so far and separately...with sniping skeleton archers.

On trip 4...we can never make it past because they are so strong the scaling feels faster than us. i wish i could share a clip here-- this happened last time i played with my 3 friends. the first camp, we get swarmed by sniper like gun guys, sniping arrow teleporting skeletons, the teleporting rogue like skeletons, the fire ghost spirit, the skull fire slime, just EVERYTHING.
every time i think i have the timing correct on the arrow and gun guys i end up dying in the sky. not just jumping, IM SO HIGH UP IN THE SKY FAR AWAY I GET SNIPED AND KILLED INSTANTLY ACROSS THE MAP. and that's while I'm dodging.
when nighttime comes, its 20x worse. we have 20+ enemies to kill and their all snipers.

the devs clearly has a thing for archers because even on trip 3 we get mostly archer enemies spawning than anything and even their scaling is suspicious.

One thing, i get annoyed by a little. we beat a boss, go to the next trip, see TWO mini boss of the big boss we just fought and their able to do the same thing the big boss was able to do along with spawning the dagger elf's...and toxic mushrooms.
we're jumping from one drift to another just to not get hit till night time is over and hope to god we don't get sniped out of nowhere.
i don't really get "Make you choice" good items to choose from it honestly always the same most times for as mage. the merchant, didn't show up on our map 2 trips in a row and that was on duos normal. we saw only 2 merchant on trip 3 and none on trip 4. even the merchant items we had found was just duplicates of what we already saw from the previous one vs 4 people we had things we've never seen before and it was always new things even with 3 people.
my husband is trying out Easy mode solo right now. he gets 1-2 enemies that spawn at night...vs us getting a big camp spawned on us including when we do trials. we cant even sit still for a second due to the spam attacks but on easy mode he can since its only 1 or 2.

the boss on easy mode, it takes him less than 30 seconds to finish him vs us with so many upgrades added on it takes way more than 30 seconds along with the boss teleporting away close to death and protecting itself. he didn't experience any of that because it was that fast and easy.
BTW HE DID ONLY ONE MOVE, the spin with the tank girl and it was that easy/quick.

when it comes to getting legendary items, we never get it not even on trip 4. on the 2nd trip, none of us are using the archer guy but that's the main item were getting. on trip 3, were getting nothing but maces and some wands. then trip 4, we could hardly afford anything and we never get a legendary weapon. were all holding 3-4k gold.
when me and my husband played, we got a legendary weapon for the first time on trip 4...it was daggers. none of us were using that class. every weapon that dropped was daggers. its like each biome is based off of the character as if its their home.

The game is good, we've played the playtest and everything but now that we have the full game and we've gotten to the 4th trip...it's completely impossible for us to get passed. we should not have to run around while shooting on trip 4. the enemies are way to strong, way too fast and this is with full loadout of epic weapons, more than 47 items including stacked, team radius healing and shield, and along with triple jump and double dodging.
when one of our friends died...there was no revive station. i looked everywhere and the moment i touch the ground and immediately jumped into the drift because i was still in it, i get sniped...we lost.

there is no way the scaling is in an ok state because even the bomb guys on the snow biome-- you see that they did a gesture that indicates they threw the bomb so i move right and for some reason the gesture is over but the bomb gets thrown late and goes to where i moved afterwards or in other cases where I'm facing to go but ahead of me as if they're trying to catch me. like...wow. its the same with the archers on the snow biome with the slow arrows shooting including the guys who throw the nets at you.

my husband is on the last trip and he is EATING his health up without having to move. 1000 hp and the boss only hitting him for 90....vs us on trip 1 were getting half our hp gone from the boss.
fix it...
